results.title: Key performance indicators for optimizing academic ...
results.content: Recent literature underscores the need to harmonize instructional design models with learning theories to enrich pedagogical effectiveness and student engagement (Abuhassna et al., Citation2024). These practices align with contemporary educational frameworks such as learning analytics and adaptive learning environments which emphasize the transformative potential of data-driven, student-centered strategies and must be the path to be follow in general online course design. Mayer identifies three core principles to enhance learning: 1) Dual channels, which underscores the value of presenting information through both auditory and visual means; 2) Limited capacity, which emphasizes designing educational material to avoid overwhelming students’ working memory; and 3) Active processing, which stresses that learners engage with material actively, organizing and integrating it meaningfully with prior knowledge. This convergence of instructional design models and foundational learning theories fosters not only the alignment of pedagogical strategies with cognitive demands, but also scaffolds student autonomy, engagement, and schema construction (Abuhassna et al., Citation2024).
